name: DonutShop v0.8.5
body:
- Experimental Firmware Updates / Rollback can show a False "Error" message starting with RetroTink Firmware 1.99.14 when updating.
  - 1.99.14 changed its response to a "fwup go \<token>" command. This update recognizes the old and new response.
  - The Firmware still gets applied regardless, this just prevents the False Error. 
- "Update Available" badge for Experimental Firmware shows w/o having to manually refresh the page when returning to an existing WebCtl session. (if an update is available of course)
